input.summary: V03 Vembanad Botanicals quoted RM-002 glycerin (INR 112/kg delivered, 500 kg MOQ) and RM-008 rosemary extract at only 10% rosmarinic acid vs 20% spec (INR 4,000/kg, 25 kg MOQ); the attached rosemary COA batch expires 30 Nov 2026, before the 20 Dec 2026 need-by, and its 10.3% result is from a 2024 batch; the proposal's 98% OTIF and 0.2% rejection claims are unverified, and the other eight lines were not addressed.
